annotations.title: Decide what AI agents may do with a site

description: For a site owner: turn yes or no answers about AI agents into the robots.txt lines that put them into effect. Answer by purpose (training, search, user, agentic) and, where wanted, for single agents by id. The result has the lines to add to robots.txt and, for every agent in the registry, its robots.txt name, what its vendor states about following robots.txt and what this site has observed. A "no" disallows the agent; a "yes" adds no line. Crawlers that also build ordinary web search (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot) are never changed by a question, only one by one. Nothing that is chosen is stored.

agentic.description: May an agent browse and act on the site for a person?

agents.description: Answers for single agents, by the id from list_agents, for example {"googlebot": "no"}. They win over the answers by purpose.

search.description: May AI search list and quote the pages?

training.description: May AI vendors use the pages to train models?

user.description: May an assistant fetch a page when a person asks about it?
